title: Route users to the nearest region
explanation: Google Cloud's global external load balancer uses a single anycast IP to route each user to the nearest healthy backend region. Cloud NAT is egress, Interconnect is on-prem connectivity, and Cloud Armor is WAF/DDoS protection.
